planning_notes: Wiring preserved: LED1..LED5 are connected from Arduino pins D2..D6 to anode side through 220Ω resistors; all cathodes are tied to GND.2. Therefore LEDs are modeled as active-high digital outputs (model true => LED ON).
Serial receive: a single physical serial input is modeled as integer with bounds 0..31 at 9600 baud using framing line_or_idle and idle_timeout_ms=20 as specified.

Serial reporting is not explicitly required by the prompt; a minimal numeric status report group is included for the last valid input value. Any additional/fixed text reporting is intentionally omitted.
Model behavior (mapping received integer bits to D2..D6 outputs, and holding previous outputs until a new valid value is received) is assumed to be implemented in SysML, not in the port definitions.
Control period chosen as 5 ms as a reasonable scheduling granularity; exact bit-update cadence and any report gating timing are handled in SysML.

interfaces.meaning: Serial number to display in binary on 5 LEDs

interfaces.name: io_5_valid
interfaces.meaning: True for this model step only when a complete valid serial frame was received; value holds its previous value otherwise

interfaces.meaning: Report current displayed 5-bit value after a valid serial number is received

# Binary LED

## Project Description
This is an arduino project that uses 5 LEDs to display the binary form of a number received over serial.

## Hardware Components
- Arduino Uno
- 220Ω resistor * 5
- LED * 5

## Circuit Description
Five LEDs are connected to Arduino Uno. LED 1 to 5 are connected to arduino pin2 to pin6 through 220Ω resistor, respectively. Cathode pin of each LEDs are connected to gnd2.

## Expected Behavior
When the Arduino powers up, it should:
1. Set pin2, pin3, pin4, pin5, pin6 pin mode as OUTPUT
3. Continuously read the serial monitor, which ranges from 0 to 31
4. With LED1 as the LSB and LED5 as the MSB, light up the LEDs that represent 1s in the binary form of the input number

## Success Criteria
The test is successful when:
1. When a number is entered via serial input, LEDs corresponding to the bits set to 1 in its binary representation are turned on.

## Notes for Implementation
- Serial input ranges from 0 to 31.

## Attributes
- To use 220Ω resistor, set the property name "value" to "220 ohm".
